subject: Reasoning
topic: Calendar — Day and Date Calculations (Set W7)

questions.stem: How many odd days are there in a non-leap year?
questions.explanation: A is correct. A non-leap year has 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. That extra 1 day is the 'odd day'. This odd day shifts what day of the week a given date falls on from one year to the next.

questions.stem: January 1, 2024 is a Monday. What day of the week is January 8, 2024?
questions.explanation: B is correct. January 8 is exactly 7 days (one complete week) after January 1. Since 7 days = 0 odd days, the day of the week repeats. Jan 1 = Monday → Jan 8 = Monday.

questions.stem: A leap year has how many odd days?
questions.explanation: B is correct. A leap year has 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. So a leap year has 2 odd days. This is why dates jump 2 weekdays after a leap year rather than just 1.

questions.stem: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be after 100 days?
questions.explanation: C is correct. 100 days from now: 100 mod 7 = 2 (since 7×14=98, remainder 2). Wednesday + 2 days = Friday.

questions.stem: If January 1 of a non-leap year falls on Monday, on what day does March 1 of the same year fall?
questions.explanation: C is correct. January has 31 days, February has 28 days (non-leap). Total from Jan 1 to Mar 1 = 31+28 = 59 days. 59 mod 7 = 3 (7×8=56, remainder 3). Monday + 3 = Thursday.

questions.stem: What is the maximum number of Sundays that can occur in a year?
questions.explanation: B is correct. A non-leap year = 52 complete weeks + 1 extra day. If that extra day is Sunday → 53 Sundays. A leap year = 52 weeks + 2 extra days; if either or both are Sunday → up to 53 Sundays. Maximum = 53 Sundays. (Both leap and non-leap years can have 53 Sundays.)

questions.stem: February 14 falls on a Tuesday in 2023. On what day will February 14 fall in 2024? (2023 is not a leap year; 2024 is a leap year.)
questions.explanation: B is correct. From Feb 14, 2023 to Feb 14, 2024: exactly 365 days pass (2023 is not a leap year — the extra Feb 29 belongs to 2024 AFTER Feb 14). 365 mod 7 = 1 odd day. Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday.

questions.stem: Today is Monday, February 24. What was the date on the previous Saturday?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Monday to previous Saturday: count back 2 days (Mon → Sun → Sat = 2 days back). Feb 24 − 2 = Feb 22. The previous Saturday was February 22.

questions.stem: How many leap years are there from 1901 to 2000 (inclusive)?
questions.explanation: B is correct. From 1901 to 2000, multiples of 4: 1904, 1908, ..., 2000 = (2000−1904)/4 + 1 = 24+1 = 25 values. Of these, 2000 is a century year divisible by 400 (leap year ✓). 1900 is excluded (before 1901). So all 25 are genuine leap years. Answer: 25.

questions.stem: The year 2000 started on Saturday (January 1, 2000 = Saturday). What day did January 1, 2001 fall on?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 2000 is a leap year: 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 odd days. Saturday + 2 = Monday. So January 1, 2001 fell on Monday. Key: a leap year contributes 2 odd days, advancing the weekday by 2 rather than the usual 1 for non-leap years.
